name: Camila Barbosa
summary: Senior Data Engineer with 9 years of experience designing scalable data architectures, real-time streaming pipelines, and distributed processing systems across leading tech companies in Latin America. Specialized in building high-throughput infrastructure processing billions of daily events with high availability and low latency. Proven track record of optimizing cloud data infrastructure costs and driving analytics reliability.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
experience.description: Architected real-time order tracking pipelines processing over 150 million daily Kafka messages using Apache Spark Structured Streaming on AWS. Reduced end-to-end event processing latency from 4.5 seconds to 350 milliseconds across core logistics microservices. Migrated batch ETL orchestrations to Apache Airflow on AWS MWAA, improving pipeline reliability to 99.98% SLA compliance for 40+ analytics stakeholders.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
experience.description: Designed and deployed credit risk features engine using Python, SQL, and Apache Spark on GCP Dataproc, serving real-time model scoring for 12M active credit card users. Optimized BigQuery and Cloud Storage resource utilization using Terraform and dbt, reducing monthly infrastructure spending by $180,000. Mentored a pod of 5 mid-level engineers on streaming state management and data quality framework adoption.

experience.title: Data Engineer
experience.description: Built automated financial reconciliation pipelines handling $40M in daily transaction volume using Python, PostgreSQL, and AWS Glue. Streamlined fraud detection dataset creation by integrating Kafka streaming pipelines with S3 data lakes, increasing fraud capture speed by 40%.
